name: Colossal Grave-Reaver
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, mill three cards.
Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put one of them onto the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put one of them onto the battlefield.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when cards matching a filter (here: creature cards, owner = you) are put into a graveyard, narrowed by `from_zones: ["library"]` (mill, surveil, self-mill costs), with `batched: true` so one simultaneous move of several creature cards triggers once ("one or more"), and binding the batch of moved cards so the effect can be `put_onto_battlefield` over exactly one of THEM chosen by the controller ("put one of them"), still in the graveyard on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield only sees permanents leaving the battlefield, dies is battlefield creatures, discard is the hand, leaves_graveyard is the reverse direction; the trigger's from_zones key is read only for spell_cast and land_played. Without the event there is also no binding for 'them', so a put_onto_battlefield over any creature card in the graveyard would wrongly reach creature cards milled earlier. The Flying keyword and the enters-or-attacks mill three (self_enters + attacks triggers with mill) are expressible today.
